blocks.text: 今天为 Chrome 用户带来几项重大升级！我们正在把 computer use 的能力带给每一位使用 Chrome 的人。

blocks.text: 首先是：ChatGPT 现在可以使用你在 Chrome 中的标签页，让回答更有用，并帮你把事情办成。

blocks.text: 如果你在 Chat 中，它可以查看你打开的标签页并收集信息。

blocks.text: 如果你在 Work 中，ChatGPT 可以控制你的 Chrome 标签页来完成任务，比如发送消息、填写表单或下载文件。它甚至能帮你整理和分组那一堆打开的标签页。

blocks.text: A few big upgrades for Chrome users today! We’re bringing the power of computer use to anyone who uses Chrome.

inlines.text: A few big upgrades for Chrome users today! We’re bringing the power of computer use to anyone who uses Chrome.

blocks.text: First up: ChatGPT can now use your tabs in Chrome to make answers more useful and get things done for you.

inlines.text: First up: ChatGPT can now use your tabs in Chrome to make answers more useful and get things done for you.

blocks.text: If you’re in Chat, it can look across your open tabs and gather info.

inlines.text: If you’re in Chat, it can look across your open tabs and gather info.

blocks.text: If you’re in Work, ChatGPT can control your Chrome tabs to get things, like sending messages, filling out forms, or downloading files. It can even help you organize and group that pile of tabs you have open.
